per_window.undetermined: From one 1994 abstract: the isolated VL self-associates weakly (Kd 2.5 ± 0.7 mM) in a rapid monomer/dimer equilibrium, which is binding kinetics, not conformational exchange (VL-J1, r1); its solution structure matches the Fab/digoxin crystal VL to 1.05 Å backbone RMSD, with subtle differences in CDR2, CDR3 and strands A, F and G (VL-J2, r2, structure_only).

protein_summary.wt_apo_answer: Not established: the RelaxDB source paper (doi:10.1002/prot.340150307), read only as an abstract, says the free isolated 26-10 VL has significant R2 exchange contributions at 24 unnamed residues on the microsecond-to-millisecond timescale, with nearby aromatic-ring motion proposed for some of them, and low ps-ns flexibility apart from 15 residues with nanosecond motion; no residue list, rate, population, regime or sample condition is available, and the domain is partly dimeric at NMR concentrations (Kd 2.5 ± 0.7 mM), so no site or rate can be given.
questions_for_gina: The 1993 backbone-dynamics paper (doi:10.1002/prot.340150307) is now in the evidence as an abstract only; can its full text (order parameters, the 24 residues with R2 exchange terms, sample conditions) be obtained, since it is the likely RelaxDB source?

At NMR concentrations the isolated VL is partly dimeric (Kd 2.5 mM): should the atlas treat the RelaxDB sample as one state, or flag relaxation and R2 exchange values as possibly raised by self-association?
protein_summary.buffer_note: The 1994 structure abstract (VL-r1, VL-r2) and the 1993 dynamics abstract (VL-VL_20261020152957-r1, r2) give no temperature, pH, buffer, concentration or ligand state, so no condition transfers to any judgment and no verdict above unresolved is possible. The isolated VL is in a rapid monomer/dimer equilibrium at NMR concentrations, so relaxation and R2 exchange values of this sample may include an association contribution. Method searches used only the exact name 'Ig kappa chain V-II region 26-10' with Mus musculus and returned zero hits for every class; the 1993 paper entered through a re-read of the RelaxDB source, not through those searches. Second reads flagged no row in either case.
